visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The video begins with a vibrant green animation featuring swirling patterns. Bold Traditional Chinese text overlays the frame, with a laughing emoji prominently displayed at the top. The visual style is fast-paced and typical of social media comedic content. (2) A transition leads into an office setting with bright studio lighting. A male character wearing a white lab-style jacket rubs his eyes with a pained expression while holding a smartphone. A female character in professional attire sits at a desk behind him, observing his actions with a serious look. The background features shelves, books, and a branded logo. (3) The female character begins to cough dramatically, clutching her throat and chest while gesturing toward the male. Her facial expressions are highly exaggerated for comedic effect. She points at him as if delivering a mystical diagnosis while he looks on with confusion and slight irritation. (4) Another animation slide appears with a pink background and swirl patterns, introducing a new segment title. The scene then shifts to a meeting room where four people are seated around a table cluttered with various objects, including a laptop and ritual-like wooden items. One female character in the center is adorned with headbands and beaded jewelry, holding a small figurine while directing the others. (5) The group is seen manipulating a small yellow crystal and a statue, adjusting its orientation on the table according to the instructions of the central female figure. The lighting remains bright and consistent throughout the scene.

narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: The video is a comedic sketch designed to satirize superstitious office behaviors in Taiwan. It uses over-the-top acting and spiritual references (like 'wuxing' and haunting) to create humor out of a common workplace complaint (eye strain).
